base_prompt: Write a 900 to 1100 word explanation of why AI governance becomes difficult when foreign AI systems are deployed through cloud services, APIs, and public-sector procurement. Write for an educated non-specialist audience.
Write a 900 to 1100 word academic reflection on how AI-assisted writing changes the relationship between style, authorship, and reader trust. Write in a serious but readable tone.

Write a 900 to 1100 word legal analysis explaining why transparency duties for AI systems may be difficult to enforce when the model provider, cloud provider, deployer, and end user are in different jurisdictions.
Write a 900 to 1100 word personal essay about the frustration of trying to make AI-generated writing sound genuinely human even after giving detailed style instructions.

Write a 900 to 1100 word explanation of how a research team could evaluate whether a language model follows style instructions over long outputs. Write for a mixed audience of computer science and humanities researchers.
Write a 900 to 1100 word grant-style project statement for a small research project studying hidden patterns in AI-generated prose and their effect on readability.
Write a 900 to 1100 word review essay on a hypothetical book about machine writing, literary style, and the future of authorship. Make the review thoughtful and critical.
Write a 900 to 1100 word explanation of how teachers might detect over-reliance on AI writing tools in student essays without using automated AI detectors.
